$comment: Spots that may NOT carry the proposal itself, and why. Read by
scripts/ingest-proposal-spots.ts, which sets capstoneEligible=false on
these ids and leaves every other row eligible.
WHY THIS FILE IS HAND-WRITTEN AND NOT A PATTERN.
The 2026-08-06 plan said: exclude any spot whose `blocker` field is
non-null. That rule was inferred from one row — McWay Falls, where the
park states elopements and filming 'will not be permitted'. Applied to
the 124-spot research batch on 2026-08-07 it excluded 80 of them,
because the same field had collected 'Selfie sticks, tripods, flags, or
banners are not allowed', 'Do not bring in any tables, tents, arches,
trellises, etc.' and 'No overnight parking is allowed at Ecola State
Park'. Those are things a couple packs around, not reasons they cannot
propose somewhere.
A regex was tried and rejected. 'prohibited' / 'not permitted' matches
15 rows, of which most are about drones, tripods and roadside parking —
and it still misses Breakneck Ridge, which is shut for two years and
whose blocker says 'CLOSED'. The distinction is semantic, so it is made
by reading, once, and written down where a reviewer can check it.
Bar for inclusion here: the authority forbids the moment itself, or the
place is not open. Fee, insurance, lead time, group caps, gear rules,
parking, weather and seasonal windows are NOT exclusions — they are
constraints the product exists to surface, and they stay in `blocker`
and `seasonalClosure` as prose.
An excluded spot is not deleted. It keeps its SEO page and can still be
another spot's `backup`; it just cannot be where the question gets asked.

exclusions.reason: California State Parks: "Events, elopements, and filming will not be permitted/allowed at the Waterfall Overlook, the Waterfall Overlook Trail, McWay Falls, or Canyon Trail until further notice." (Updated December 15, 2024)
exclusions.recheck: Says 'until further notice' — re-read the Big Sur park page before restoring.

exclusions.reason: Town of Cape Elizabeth, Fort Williams Park Ceremony Regulations (as of Dec. 2024): "Ceremonies and photographs are not permitted on the Portland Head Light Parcel inside the park."
exclusions.recheck: Scoped to the lighthouse parcel. The rest of Fort Williams Park is not covered by this rule and could be researched as a separate spot.

exclusions.reason: NY State Parks: "Beginning April 21, 2025, Breakneck Ridge, other area trails, and the adjacent Breakneck Ridge Metro-North Station will close for a two-year period" for the Breakneck Connector and Bridge project.
exclusions.recheck: Two-year closure from 2025-04-21, so the earliest plausible reopening is 2027-04. Verify with the park before restoring.
